morphology.pattern_note: 元音 a 前，meN- 实现为 meng-；词根首元音保留。此处属于表示漂浮的 ambang II，不是表示门槛或临界点的 ambang I。

senses.zh_definition: 漂浮、悬浮或飘荡于水面或空中；也形容月亮仿佛浮现在天空。
senses.en_definition: To float or remain suspended on water or in the air; also used of the moon appearing to float in the sky.
senses.ms_definition: Terapung atau terkatung-katung di atas air atau di udara; melayang-layang.
senses.nuances: 不及物用法，侧重物体浮着或悬着的状态。bulan mengambang 常见于描写月色的文字；日常说明漂浮现象也常用 terapung。这里依据输入词根收录漂浮义，不并入其他词根下的同形词义。[DBP PRPM：mengambang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=mengambang)

collocations.en: the moon floating in the sky

dual_scenarios.ms: Bulan mengambang di langit ketika persembahan kebudayaan itu bermula.
dual_scenarios.zh: 文化表演开始时，一轮明月浮现在天空。
dual_scenarios.en: The moon hung in the sky as the cultural performance began.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tengok bulan mengambang kat atas sana, cantiklah!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Lihatlah bulan yang mengambang di langit itu; sungguh cantik!
dual_scenarios.zh: 你看天上那轮月亮，真美啊！
dual_scenarios.en: Look at the moon up there—it's beautiful!
spoken_features: tengok 是口语常用的看，对应较正式的 lihat
kat 在此对应表示位置的 di

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Tengok bulan mengambang kat atas sana, cantiklah!
messages.ms_standard: Lihatlah bulan yang mengambang di langit itu; sungguh cantik!
messages.zh: 你看天上那轮月亮，真美啊！
messages.en: Look at the moon up there—it's beautiful!

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ha, awan dah beralih. Nampak jelas sekarang!
messages.ms_standard: Ya, awan sudah beralih. Bulan kelihatan jelas sekarang!
messages.zh: 对啊，云已经飘开了，现在看得好清楚！
messages.en: Yeah, the clouds have moved. You can see it clearly now!

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect this floating sense with ambang II and cross-reference kambang. Their examples place the moon in the eastern sky, apparently suspended above the landscape. That image gives learners a memorable connection between physical floating and literary description. The dictionary evidence supports this relationship, but does not establish a dated origin or an earlier ancestral form. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=mengambang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 me.ngam.bang 配成三拍画面：月亮升起、停在半空、轻轻飘着；记住 mengambang＝浮着、悬着。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 本词没有敬语或贬义色彩。描写月亮时带有文学感；向长辈或客户表达赞叹，可说 Bulan kelihatan cantik malam ini。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合自然描写、诗歌和赏月聊天。表达价格浮动、汇率浮动或事情悬而未决时，应另选符合具体语境的表达，不能直接套用这里的漂浮义。
